svg.title: Spatial MoS2 projected DOS: pristine and near-edge sulfur vacancies
svg.desc: Native energy and position strips from summed Mo and S atom projections per Mo. Shared energy interval minus 0.4 to plus 1.4 eV and linear 0 to 7 states per eV per Mo color scale. Dashed line marks the Fermi level. No edge guide, artificial gap zeroing, data interpolation, or fitted barrier is applied. Gray margins lie outside the native spatial strips.
